title: MemoryItemQdrantPayload
description: Qdrant point payload for a MemoryItem (src/shared/models/__init__.py:MemoryItem.model_dump(mode='json')), as written by every upsert/upsert_batch call in src/shared/qdrant_client.py. The 'schema_version' key is NOT a MemoryItem model field — it is stamped onto the payload dict at write time by QdrantClient.upsert/upsert_batch (qdrant_client.py:189,223) via payload.setdefault semantics, so every point ever written through that path carries it even though the domain model stays storage-agnostic. The point's dense vector itself is stored in Qdrant's native vector slot, not in this payload (the 'embedding' key below is a MemoryItem field that is left null in practice).

schema_version.description: Stamped by QdrantClient.upsert/upsert_batch, not by the MemoryItem model itself.

embedding.description: Always null in practice; the real vector lives in Qdrant's vector slot, set by QdrantClient.upsert's separate vector argument
